wins.text: Data Center segment revenue grew 38% YoY and 43% sequentially to a record $2.3B in Q4, with both server CPU and Data Center GPU setting quarterly and annual revenue records.
MI300X data center GPU revenue exceeded the $400M Q4 expectation, driven by faster-than-expected customer qualification and ramp; full-year 2024 GPU revenue guidance raised from >$2B to >$3.5B.
Client segment revenue rose 62% YoY to $1.5B, swinging from an operating loss of $152M a year ago to operating income of $55M.
Embedded segment design wins exceeded $10B in 2023, up more than 25% vs. 2022, underpinning long-term growth confidence despite near-term inventory headwinds.
Q4 non-GAAP EPS of $0.77 increased 12% YoY; full-year share repurchases of $985M with $5.6B remaining authorization.

risks.text: Gaming segment revenue declined 17% YoY and 9% sequentially to $1.4B; management now expects annual Gaming revenue to decline by a significant double-digit percentage YoY in 2024 as the console cycle enters year 5 and customer inventory remains elevated. Q1 sequential decline expected to exceed 30%.

Embedded segment revenue fell 24% YoY and 15% sequentially to $1.1B; customers continue to work down inventory levels with demand expected to remain soft through H1 2024 and Q2 expected to be sequentially flattish vs. Q1.
Traditional (non-AI) server CPU market described as 'still mixed, especially into the first half of the year' with ongoing cloud optimization and cautious enterprise spending.
MI300 supply chain described as tight in H1 2024, with more capacity coming online in H2; execution risk remains on yield, testing time, and gross margin improvement for the GPU ramp.

Data Center GPU gross margins are currently below corporate average and accretive improvement is still in progress; Embedded segment margin headwind (44% segment margin) persists through H1 as high-margin Embedded revenue declines.

guidance_items.detail: Q1 2024 revenue guided to ~$5.4B +/- $300M; Data Center GPU 2024 revenue outlook raised from >$2B to >$3.5B, with sequential growth expected in Q1.
Q1 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~52%, up ~120 bps from Q4's 51%; full-year 2024 gross margin expected to expand vs. 2023.
Gaming segment Q1 sequential decline expected to exceed 30%; full-year Gaming revenue expected to decline by significant double-digit percentage YoY.
Embedded segment Q1 expected to decline low double-digit percentage sequentially; Q2 expected to be roughly flat vs. Q1; recovery expected in H2 2024.
Management committed to EPS growth faster than top-line revenue growth in 2024, implying operating leverage expansion.
Non-GAAP operating expenses guided to ~$1.73B in Q1; non-GAAP effective tax rate of 13%; diluted share count ~1.63B shares.
